caption: The video captures a youth hockey player in a white jersey with maroon trim and the number 82 skating across indoor ice while stickhandling a black puck on a CCM stick. He wears a black helmet, orange-and-black gloves, and green-laced skates, his legs alternating between extended pushes and tucked recoveries as he moves. In the opening frames an opponent in a purple jersey and white helmet holds position on the right and a partial player in white appears at the far left, but both drift out of view as the sequence progresses. The camera tightens its framing on the central player, the yellow kickplate and boards sliding upward until his helmet is cropped from the top of the shot. Throughout, the puck stays close to his blade, sometimes resting against it and at other moments nudged slightly ahead to his left with the blade trailing behind. His upper body remains hunched over the stick, head tracking the play, as the maneuver continues without a visible start or finish. The final frames show only his torso, legs, stick, and the puck gliding on the white ice.
